reasons: The unstudentized event Rademacher quantile can be identically zero for a degenerate or rare triangular-array component. A uniform conditional variance lower bound supplies the Lindeberg and scale stability needed by the retained event multiplier construction.

Conditional independence after conditioning on the complete historical design does not eliminate covariance created by design-dependent conditional event means. This condition removes that shared component while retaining nonidentically distributed bounded outcomes.

Centering only on the contemporaneous coordinate permits every replicate to share a design-measurable omitted component. Full-design centering makes the existing conditional cross-unit independence deliver the advertised replication gain.

narrow: The random-spacing experiment is separated by the positive probability that no design point falls in the local bump. With replicated responses, the usual bump pair has Kullback--Leibler divergence of order \(n_sT^{-2\lambda/d}\), which is unbounded in allowed growth regimes. A uniform lower bound on testing affinity is the correct and sufficient Le Cam premise; bounded Kullback--Leibler divergence remains available for the other three channels.

narrow: The frozen claim is not valid uniformly over its stated constants or dimensions. The witness definition fixes one cohort and two return horizons, while an unrestricted amplitude need not satisfy the maintained bounded-wealth and conditional-variance restrictions. The narrowed statement exposes sufficient support, variance, smoothness, query-region, and dimension conditions without assuming the nonidentification conclusion.

narrow: The displayed multiplier interval is not uniformly honest under the current sampling assumptions. Conditional independence given the full design permits a common random event mean, and when the number of local calendar sites stays bounded the delete-block statistic has only finitely many influential pseudo-scores. The proposed claim adds the missing mean and variance conditions and restricts this particular block multiplier to the dense-local-design regime; the spacing regime needs a different within-site calibration.
The proved narrowed claim is algebraic and no longer consumes the unresolved sharp-frontier theorem.

narrow: The algebraic rate diagram is valid, but its unconditional minimax interpretation inherits the sharp-frontier theorem that the counterexample invalidates on the frozen class. The proposed claim preserves the exact domination, boundary, saturation, and absence of a training-coordinate deconvolution term while making the sharp-risk interpretation explicitly conditional on a valid frontier.
The narrowed sharp-frontier claim depends directly on the two proposed full-design sampling assumptions.

narrow: The frozen class permits design-measurable conditional event means and historical errors shared by every replicate. The explicit obstruction shows that the risk of the advertised estimator then stays bounded away from zero while the four-term frontier vanishes. Restricting to full-design event-mean stability and historical centering removes exactly those extra common-noise channels without assuming the desired rate conclusion.

verdict.note: Accept transparent full-design centering and faithful frontier/embedding corrections; reject avoidable variance floor and dense-local-site interval narrowing, to be replaced by all-regime unit-cluster Hoeffding construction.
